name: search-box
title: Search box
description: The search box and the library's input group: the question, attached files, the plus for more data, the scope, the Enter cue and the red arrow.
use_for: Asking a question of the data; any field with controls before and after it (the input group).
never: Red on the box itself: the arrow is the only red
body: `v-model` is the question; Enter searches and Shift+Enter breaks the line. `attached` lists files (`adding`, `added`, `failed`) that the app owns: the box emits `files` when they are picked or dropped, `paste` with pasted text, `remove` with a key, `connect` for Connect an app, and `submit` with the question. The add menu names `target`; turn it off with `:add-menu="false"`. The `scope` slot takes where it looks: the console's `scope-menu`. `busy` shows the dot matrix in the arrow while the search runs.
